26V731000.Summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2027 i7 50xDrive, i7 60xDrive, 2026-2027 i5 xDrive40, i5 eDrive40, and i5 M60 vehicles. The high voltage battery charging software may be incorrect.
26V731000.Consequence: Software that does not charge the battery properly can lead to electric shock, increasing the risk of injury.
26V731000.Remedy: Dealers will update the high voltage battery charging software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 25, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 25, 2026.

26V729000.Summary: Spencer Manufacturing, Inc. (Spencer) is recalling certain 2026 Rescue, 2025 Initial Attack, and 2024-2025 Pumper emergency vehicles. The display may stop responding to touch commands or fail to power on, preventing the activation of exterior emergency lights, fire fighting and other emergency equipment.
26V729000.Consequence: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. Inoperative equipment can delay emergency response, increasing the risk of injury.
26V729000.Remedy: Spencer will work with Hale Products to update the firmware and install a monitor system, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 21, 2026. Owners may contact customer service at 1-269-637-8721.

26V734000.Summary: Lamar Trailers, Inc (Lamar Trailers) is recalling certain 2021-2027 gooseneck trailers. The spare tire may be improperly secured, allowing the spare tire to detach.
26V734000.Consequence: A detached tire can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V734000.Remedy: Dealers will replace the mounting hardware, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 4, 2027. Owners may contact Lamar Trailers' customer service at 903-782-9333.

26V745000.Summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2026 Thrive travel trailers. The original Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) and Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) were not listed the certification label after vehicle alterations. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."
26V745000.Consequence: If the values of the GVWR and GAWR differ from the original label values, it can lead to unintentionally overloading the trailer, increasing the risk of a crash.
26V745000.Remedy: Winnebago will provide corrected labels, free of charge. Owner letters are expected to be mailed January 7, 2027. Owners may contact Winnebago customer service at 1-574-825-5280 Ext. 5220. Winnebago's number for this recall is 44448365.

26V739000.Summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2017, 2020-2026 Utilimaster Upfit vehicles. The tire and loading label may not list the combined weight value. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard Number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."
26V739000.Consequence: Missing information may lead to unintentionally overloading the tires, increasing the risk of tire failure and a crash.
26V739000.Remedy: Shyft will supply new labels, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 4, 2026. Owners may contact Shyft customer service at 1-800-237-7806. Shyft's number for this recall is 26-08.
